DeviceOn for Edge AI also provides real-time monitoring and management from edge AI devices to cloud-based AI. Combined with server-class AI performance, an industrial-grade design, and edge management, the AIR-030 series is the ideal solution for AGV, AMR, robotics, and video analytics applications.
